name: Tsukioka Akira
source:
Grade: 2nd year, Sakura Group
Affiliation: The gardening club

Akira is a pretty average guy, with the exception of his feminine looks. He is kind, a donkan and also very hilarious, as sometimes he get’s toyed with by everyone because of his submissive demeanor.

Akira's twin sister [url=/c13087]Akiko[/url] is sickly and is in the hospital, so she can’t go to school. The problem is that she’s been sick for too long and she may have to repeat the year, or even drop out of school. So his parents decided to send him, the splitting image of his sister, over to the all-girls prestigious school to go undercover as his sister, and live her life for a while so that when she comes back, she can take his place without dropping out of school or repeating a year.

Since he gets easily swept away by the situation, he gave in to his parents' idea and he becomes more and more of a girl deeper in the story because of his attitude. Since Akira did go to replace Akiko without her permission, every time he makes a mistake he gets shouted at by his sister through the phone. 

[Edited from Accany's [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2009/05/31/花と乙女に祝福を-review/]review[/url]]
